stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena sees a plant growing near the wall of her school garden in Jaipur. It is not very tall, has many hard, woody brown stems that branch out close to the ground, and has no single main trunk. Which of the following statements about this plant is correct ( )
A. It is a tree, because its stem is hard and woody
B. It is a shrub, because it has many woody stems branching near the ground
C. It is a herb, because it is not very tall
D. It is a climber, because it is growing near a wall

options.text: It is a tree, because its stem is hard and woody
It is a shrub, because it has many woody stems branching near the ground
It is a herb, because it is not very tall
It is a climber, because it is growing near a wall

teacher.key_rationale: Shrubs are shorter than trees and have many hard woody stems branching close to the ground with no single trunk, matching the described plant. Hardness alone does not make it a tree (A wrong: trees branch higher up with one thick trunk); herbs have soft green stems (C wrong); climbers have weak stems needing support, not woody ones (D wrong). Key recalculated as B.
